integrity: Exact algebraic reduction and error-bounded expansion; numerical code is supplementary, not a certificate of the uniform claims.
scientific_limitations: The known algebraic limit-cycle existence and qualitative heteroclinic escape are credited to prior work. The present proof concerns the specified oval and its affine geometry; complete historical priority, especially the 1973 original, is not independently established.
title: Exact geometric blow-up and two-term area law for the Filiptsov algebraic limit cycle
